---
title: Scholar metadata for a complete bibliography
format: html
google-scholar: true
bibliography: references.bib
nocite: '@*'
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElementCount:
        - selectors: ['meta[name="citation_reference"]', '.csl-entry[id^="ref-"]']
          counts: [3, 3]
---

This article explicitly includes every entry in its bibliography.
